text: If rain's smallest fingers tremble on your face and slide; if the light cloak of the breeze wraps you; if the mirror smiles whenever you look at it; and many breasts rise from the sea toward the clear light of warm hands; let my fingers draw your image in a long, trembling caress; let my arms encircle your shoulders with a sharp, possessive bearing; let my face float in the radiant dark circles of your pupils; and grant full freedom to these hands that long to make you mine.

translation.title: Let Me
